meta.name: Highway Dividend + Reviewed Operating Data V5.4f
meta.objective: Test whether the highway dividend and segment-purity hypothesis remains usable after requiring original annual-report operating-disclosure evidence. Reviewed operating data is used as a PIT data-quality gate, not as certified numeric alpha.

universe.name: A-share toll-road operators with PIT segment evidence and reviewed operating disclosure
universe.construction: JoinQuant HY03160 highway industry membership filtered by visible Eastmoney/Tushare segment evidence and original annual-report operating-disclosure review. Exact traffic, toll revenue and concession numeric values are not yet promoted.

data.vendor: JoinQuant/DataJQ + Eastmoney F10 BusinessAnalysis + Tushare disclosure_date + CNINFO annual-report operating-disclosure review
data.segment_visibility_policy: latest segment evidence with visible_date <= trade_date
data.reviewed_operating_visibility_policy: latest reviewed annual-report operating disclosure with visible_date <= trade_date
data.operating_field_policy: V5.4f only certifies disclosure availability for traffic/toll table, toll revenue evidence, concession evidence and toll policy evidence. It does not certify exact numeric values.
data.source_warning: Reviewed operating disclosure currently covers a small original-report sample only. PM must block Engineering handoff unless coverage is sufficient.

factors.name: highway_revenue_ratio
factors.source: Eastmoney F10 segment evidence joined with visible report date and spot-checked against annual reports
factors.definition: Revenue ratio classified as toll-road/highway/road-bridge business.

factors.name: non_highway_revenue_ratio
factors.source: Eastmoney F10 segment evidence joined with visible report date and spot-checked against annual reports
factors.definition: Revenue ratio not classified as highway/toll-road business.

factors.name: capex_burden
factors.definition: Capex divided by operating cash flow.

factors.name: reviewed_operating_disclosure_score
factors.source: CNINFO annual-report candidate evidence reviewed by operating-disclosure category
factors.definition: Share of reviewed operating disclosure categories available from original annual-report evidence.

scoring.value_trap_guard: Reviewed operating disclosure is required by panel construction; exact operating numeric values remain blocked.

portfolio.cash_policy: hold residual cash when fewer than 8 names pass filters

defensive_rule.reason: V5.4f tests operating-data review gating, not timing.

individual_stop_loss_take_profit.reason: Fixed exits are not part of the research hypothesis.

validation.acceptance_rule: V5.4f can move to Engineering only if reviewed operating PIT coverage is broad enough and validation is stable. Small-sample returns cannot pass the gate.
